OWNER APPROVAL — PHASE 1 ENGINEERING OS ACTIVATION

Approved.

Proceed with Phase 1 only.

Authorized actions:
1. Activate the IVX Engineering Operating System.
2. Keep the existing IVX platform only (no second application).
3. Complete all remaining engineering tasks using the Engineering OS pipeline.
4. Fix every production bug one by one.
5. Run full regression tests after every fix.
6. Deploy only through the Release Manager pipeline.
7. Update GitHub, Render, and Supabase only after successful QA.
8. Generate a Developer Proof Ledger entry for every completed task.
9. Send an automatic progress report every 2 hours.

Do NOT:
- Skip QA.
- Skip owner approval.
- Skip health verification.
- Mark VERIFIED without evidence.
- Deploy if any regression fails.

Required evidence for every completed task:
- Task ID
- Files changed
- GitHub Commit SHA
- Render Deployment ID
- Live /health HTTP 200
- Test results (unit, integration, regression)
- Production verification
- Proof Ledger ID

After Phase 1 is complete, stop and provide a COMPLETE/PARTIAL/BLOCKED report before beginning Phase 2.

No task may be marked VERIFIED without the evidence above.
